limitations: Restricted to unit-weight balanced double-star trees, the [2/2] Padé heat step, and exact arithmetic. No assertion of universal smallest reversible Markov dimension; possible equivalent unindexed prior specializations.
scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for each integer at least two leaves at each hub; exact rational/symbolic verification supplementary. Results concern the completed Padé step, not physical heat flow or internal stage monotonicity.
title: Two disjoint positivity windows for fourth-order Gauss diffusion on double-star trees
